verdict.rationale: Tilled documents API equivalents for several Dashboard functions: disputes through the DisputesAPI, closing batches via API, creating payment intents, webhooks, and building your own onboarding UI. However, nothing in the evidence claims API–UI parity. Several workflows are documented only through the Dashboard, including generating API keys, viewing payout speed and creating pricing templates. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity commitment, documented API paths for API-key generation, pricing templates and payout settings, and independent corroboration that UI-only actions do not exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
